newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian Merukh says delays lawsuit on Bre-X.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian Merukh says delays lawsuit on Bre-X.

text.p: Indonesian businessman Jusuf Merukh, who is claiming 40 percent of the Busang gold find in East Kalimantan, said on Wednesday he has delayed an intended $1.9 billion lawsuit against his partner Bre-X Minerals Ltd until December 4.
He also said that his claim on the find, majority-owned by Bre-X, has not been affected by talks between Bre-X and Barrick Gold Corp to form a joint-venture to exploit Busang.
"Bre-X has asked me to extend my (lawsuit) deadline to December 4 (from November 22)," Merukh told Reuters.
"It's because they are busy...possibly because of the talks with Barrick," he said. "My 40-percent ownership (claim) in Busang is unchanged despite the talks between Bre-X and Barrick."
Merukh said the talks could possibly be over a partnership to operate the find and not over ownership.
"I will welcome it if Barrick is involved in operating the mine, as neither Bre-X nor I have the expertise," he said.
"I expect the ownership dispute to be resolved before Christmas," he added.
